messages.subject: Re: fmin=.05
parts: I got fmin=.05. How do I increase the accuracy of optimization so that I can get fmin<.001.

Do you expect your model to fit these particular data perfectly?  fmin is not a measure of the accuracy of optimization, per se, but a measure of the discrepancy between predictions and observations.  If you are using MLE with complete data, it is this minimum fit function:


But you can send control options to the optimizer (e.g., # of iterations, tolerance, step size) if you think the optimizer settled in a local minimum.  See the control argument in the ?lavaan help page.

Terry
